purpose: Trace each controllable-flux scheme to reproducible simulation, architecture verification, or the next numeric model required. Passing tests prove the coverage record is complete, not that every scheme has reached final engineering validation.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-001 sweeps negative id operating points under voltage/current constraints and identifies the 100 Nm reachable boundary.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Add temperature-dependent id_min(T) demagnetization feasibility to the search candidate filter.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-001 includes minimum-current target torque points and max-feasible-torque MTPV-style points across speed.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Unify search interfaces and generate a dedicated control LUT with mode transition continuity checks.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-005 sweeps explicit k_mod voltage-utilization factors and applies parametric harmonic-current, torque-ripple, and inverter-loss penalties for overmodulation tradeoff ranking.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Replace parametric harmonic penalties with PWM waveform reconstruction, device loss maps, and EMI/current-ripple limits.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-006 validates a synthetic lambda_d/lambda_q LUT, bounds checks, bilinear interpolation, and nonlinear dq torque calculation before FEA-derived maps are available.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Replace synthetic LUT with FEA or dyno-derived lambda_d/lambda_q maps and couple interpolation to voltage/loss/thermal constraints.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-003 scales Ld/Lq/saliency and ranks candidates as a clean-room proxy before real FEA.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Replace scaled Ld/Lq proxy with FEA-derived lambda_d/lambda_q candidate maps.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-003 covers lower psi_f and higher saliency variants that approximate PMaSynRM design directions.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Add PM fraction and torque ripple screening fields instead of only psi/Ld/Lq scaling.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-002 sweeps virtual psi_f states for high/mid/low flux comparison.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Add state transition energy, state confidence, and unknown-state derating to the variable flux experiment.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-007 sweeps equivalent field current, calculates psi_eff = psi_pm + kf * if, field copper loss, target-speed reachability, and combined-loss tradeoff.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Add field winding L/R dynamics, exciter/rectifier loss, thermal coupling, and flux saturation maps.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-008 maps series/base/parallel winding configurations to Ke/Kt proxy flux, Rs, Ld/Lq, Imax, target-speed reachability, and a transition continuity check.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Replace scale factors with winding CAD/FEA parameters and add switching transient, contactor/solid-state loss, insulation, and circulating-current models.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-009 models healthy/lost phase-group cases, current-sharing imbalance, aggregate current derating, and target-speed reachability under degraded operation.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Add harmonic-subspace control, open-phase voltage-vector limits, neutral shift, and per-phase thermal RC models.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-004 applies Rs(T), psi_f(T), Vdc derating, and simplified id_min(T) demag limits to target-torque reachability.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Replace simplified demag line with FEA or magnet datasheet-derived id_min(T, fault) tables.

schemes.coverage_note: EXP-010 applies traceable speed/loss/risk weights to existing experiment outputs and emits a ranked candidate table for Pareto-style scheme selection.
schemes.next_simulation_step: Replace v0 weights with drive-cycle energy bins, thermal mission profiles, cost/mass constraints, and calibrated safety-case risk factors.
